clips.title: The story
paras: "A Firm Response" is a Horde quest on Zephras Isle issued by Ayessa Dawnsinger. Tensions are boiling over as the mysterious High Order intrudes upon the territory and dealings of the local Windshapers. Ayessa orders a preemptive strike against Belathaan Brightwish on the road to the Shrine of Akir to establish clear boundaries through force.

The Windshapers of Zephras Isle do not tolerate uninvited scrutiny, especially from an organization as secretive and calculating as the High Order. Prior warnings have gone unheeded, forcing Ayessa Dawnsinger to escalate the matter. To safeguard their interests, she chooses to intercept Belathaan Brightwish in the isolated stretch of road leading north toward the Shrine of Akir, ensuring the altercation stays away from prying eyes in town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The High Order was meeting with the Al'Aketh to discuss peace? There is no peace with the cult, they are murderous zealots. What was Elaadrin thinking sending Belathaan to treat with them alone?
Pay this no mind, friend. You are not at fault for this. The arrogance of the High Order is to blame, yet again. You were merely in the right place at the wrong time.
